title: I Made a Diablo-Like Online Game
author: Own-Kaleidoscope3695
selftext:
Hi everyone! I'm a game developer, 

and I used to work on several MMORPGs professionally.

Back then, though, 

MMORPG development was always a massive undertaking that required a large team. 

I've often wondered whether it would be possible for me to make a simpler MMORPG-style game on my own.



Since AI started becoming popular, 

I've experimented with several different technical approaches, letting AI handle most of the programming. As AI models have continued to improve, I've recently made some major progress.

And the result is the game you can see in the video.



For the multiplayer side, I'm mainly using Colyseus.io. I tested it through several prototypes beforehand, and I've been very happy with it.

The WebSocket-based architecture also has some nice advantages, 

especially when integrating the game with various cloud services.

Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 have also been a huge help throughout development.



The video itself was created with the help of Opus 5.5. To demonstrate what the game looks like with multiple players, it even wrote bot scripts for the game to simulate a multiplayer environment.



The visuals are still quite simple at the moment, but one thing I'm especially happy with is that AI can help create entire pieces of game content.

For example, I can simply describe what I want a monster to look like and how its abilities should work, and AI can turn that description into new playable content.



That's something I've been really satisfied with.

The game is already online, and so far, more than 300 accounts have been registered.

There's still a lot of content I want to add, but I've really been enjoying the development process.

The server is currently located in Asia, so players farther away may experience some latency. 

I'll continue working on improving that as well!

comments.author: HellkickDev
comments.body: It clearly is an Ai generated game. Don't take it as a personal attack. Focus on making the game look less Ai generated and more AA games studio. It will take some time. Experiment and learn. I wish you luck and happy learning.
